messages:
maria: Heads-up — int8 build of raven-lite on the dedicated canary is showing ~0.8% structured-output attr drop on funcalls vs fp16. attaching a couple of sample diffs shortly.

eli: Which attribute is drifting? missing fields, malformed JSON, or semantic differences?

maria: Mostly missing the optional "metadata" object and occasional whole-toolcall drops. Example from canary (fp16 returns full):
```
{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"redwood inference"},"metadata":{"src":"web"}}
```
But int8 sometimes returns: `{"tool":"search"}` or even `{"tool":"search",}` (trailing comma).

jon: Is this happening on streaming responses or after post-processing? any correlation with batch size / kv-cache reuse?

maria: Preliminary telemetry points to suffix truncation correlated with batch-size>1 and kv-cache reuse. Only reproducible on int8 canary. FP16 mirror is fine. sample ids: 9876 / 9877.

tara: deploy-bot just rolled a tiny parser-tolerance patch yesterday — do we know if that landed on the canary node-group?

deploy-bot: rolled raven-lite-int8 -> node-group-7 at 2024-06-12T16:34Z :rocket:

eli: We shouldn't rely on a tolerant parser to hide the bug. Proposed plan: run a mirrored-synchronous mode for the next 2k requests (mirror to fp16), capture structured diffs, and run targeted microbench with batch-size=1 and batch-size=4. Also add randomized retry jitter + increase parse-lint strictness in the eval harness.

maria: I can kick off the mirrored run tonight and push an eval set of ~200 prompts that exercise nested toolcalls to /evals/struct-int8-gap. Will record full token streams and failure windows.

jon: Add an assertion in the harness that validates the JSON against the schema and, on failure, records token-level logprobs +/- 32 tokens around the error. That will help determine whether it's generator-level token dropout or a kernel/truncation issue.

tara: If kv-cache/batching interaction is confirmed, short-term mitigation: disable kv-prefix reuse for int8 until kernel patch lands. Long-term: kernel fixes + a rollout gate that auto-fallbacks to fp16 if structured-acceptance drops >0.5% over a sliding 1h window.

maria: Opening a canary-run issue now and will tag infra + runtime with reproducer and sample payloads.

eli: Thanks — ping this thread once the mirrored run finishes so we can analyze diffs. :thumbsup:
